title: Finiteness of invariant sections with structural coefficients
statement: For a projective finite-type k-scheme X, an ample invertible module L and PGL-linearization E [def-sfb-pgl-linearized-polarization], the invariant section algebra is finitely generated over k with its specified constants. More precisely, there is a map φ:k→E.CoefficientRing into degree zero whose coefficientVal is constantSection, such that its composite into E.invariantRing is finite type, and E.CoefficientRing is a finite k-module. No assumption that H⁰(X,O_X)=k is made.

source.place: MFK GIT Chapter 1 Theorem 1.10 and Appendix 1.C; Alper arXiv:1005.2398v3 Sections 8–9. The source-specific proof is written in the Lean docstring. Section-ring action uses Stacks 02KH; section finiteness uses Stacks 0B5T. Local MFK book is WANTED.

proof.text: Use a positive very ample power from IsAmple as polarization. Projective section finiteness gives a finite-type section ring and finite-dimensional degree zero.

Use the induced affine action and finite generation of reductive invariants. Transport the invariant algebra along the equality of subrings. The degree-zero projection restricts constants to the coefficient ring.

Evaluate a homogeneous degree-zero element in degree zero. This is an injective k-linear map into the finite-dimensional degree-zero section module, proving coefficient finiteness. Tensor multiplication in degree zero is scalar multiplication.

lean.statement:
theorem invariant_section_finiteness
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (X : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (hprojective : IsHProjective X.hom)
    (hfiniteType : LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom ∧ QuasiCompact X.hom)
    (L : X.left.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hample : IsAmple X.hom L)
    (E : Action k r X L) :
    ∃ φ : k →+* E.CoefficientRing,
      (∀ c : k, E.coefficientVal (φ c) = constantSection (Z := X) (L := L) c) ∧
      ((algebraMap (E.invariantGrade 0) E.invariantRing).comp φ).FiniteType ∧
      @Module.Finite k E.CoefficientRing _ _ φ.toAlgebra.toModule
